probes.name: fresh-display-error-no-cf
probes.source:
Function ReadFailure() As String
Dim o As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set o=Application.Caller.DisplayFormat
ReadFailure="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadFailure=CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As FormatCondition
Range("B1").Formula="=ReadFailure()"
Application.CalculateFull
Probe=CStr(Range("B1").Value2)
End Function

probes.name: fresh-display-error-with-cf
probes.source:
Function ReadFailure() As String
Dim o As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set o=Application.Caller.DisplayFormat
ReadFailure="OK"
Exit Function
Failed:
ReadFailure=CStr(Err.Number) & "|" & Err.Description
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As FormatCondition
Set f=Range("B1").FormatConditions.Add(xlExpression,Formula1:="=TRUE")
f.Font.Bold=True
Range("B1").Formula="=ReadFailure()"
Application.CalculateFull
Probe=CStr(Range("B1").Value2)
End Function
